selection: Explicit relative numeric NTP/PPS allowlist only; every main-window exchange and PPS record. No raw logs, network identifiers, factory bindings, credentials or images.
transformations: Subtract native capture start from local timestamps
Subtract first accepted NTP UTC-minus-local offset from later offsets
Retain phase-origin modulo1s only; no absolute UTC epoch
Invalid PPS numeric fields empty with original validity flags; local_us=0 sentinel
Evaluate unchanged private sealed model for every qualified later PPS
raw_reproduction_limit: Private raw clock/map histories unavailable publicly; selected derivatives reproduce estimator and error summaries but not physical event timestamps.

between_run_changes.field04: SL0.2.3 character-wise VFS/4096B TX ring; separate boot
between_run_changes.field05: SL0.2.4 direct complete-frame writes/65536B TX ring; new boot
between_run_changes.unchanged: NTP timing endpoints, request schedule, MIN_RTT8, offline frozen selection/gate/weight/base rules
between_run_changes.refitted: Each boot gets a fresh NTP-derived rate and GNSS measured fixed base
between_run_changes.limitation: Not a matched same-firmware repeat. Diagnostic CPU load, software timing and thermal/boot state may confound the outcome; cause unassigned.

controlled_comparison: field05 and field06 same installed SL024 image and same boot verified locally. Elapsed time and environmental/thermal conditions remain uncontrolled. Secondary longspan model predeclared and sealed before current future error inspection; same field06 witnesses.
CSV_packaging: LF line endings; numeric content unchanged from selected relative derivatives.
